targetTexts.1: My son, keep my words and treasure my commandments within you.
targetTexts.2: Keep my commandments and live; guard my teachings as the apple of your eye.
targetTexts.3: Tie them to your fingers; write them on the tablet of your heart.
targetTexts.4: Say to wisdom, “You are my sister,” and call understanding your kinsman,
targetTexts.5: that they may keep you from the adulteress, from the stranger with seductive words.
targetTexts.6: For at the window of my house I looked through the lattice.
targetTexts.7: I saw among the simple, I noticed among the youths, a young man lacking judgment,
targetTexts.8: crossing the street near her corner, strolling down the road to her house,
targetTexts.9: at twilight, as the day was fading into the dark of the night.
targetTexts.10: Then a woman came out to meet him, with the attire of a harlot and cunning of heart.
targetTexts.11: She is loud and defiant; her feet do not remain at home.
targetTexts.12: Now in the street, now in the squares, she lurks at every corner.
targetTexts.13: She seizes him and kisses him; she brazenly says to him:
targetTexts.14: “I have made my peace offerings; today I have paid my vows.
targetTexts.15: So I came out to meet you; I sought you, and I have found you.
targetTexts.16: I have decked my bed with coverings, with colored linen from Egypt.
targetTexts.17: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, with aloes, and with cinnamon.
targetTexts.18: Come, let us take our fill of love till morning. Let us delight in loving caresses!
targetTexts.19: For my husband is not at home; he has gone on a long journey.
targetTexts.20: He took with him a bag of money and will not return till the moon is full.”
targetTexts.21: With her great persuasion she entices him; with her flattering lips she lures him.
targetTexts.22: He follows her on impulse, like an ox going to the slaughter, like a deer bounding into a trap,
targetTexts.23: until an arrow pierces his liver, like a bird darting into a snare—not knowing it will cost him his life.
targetTexts.24: Now, my sons, listen to me, and attend to the words of my mouth.
targetTexts.25: Do not let your heart turn aside to her ways; do not stray into her paths.
targetTexts.26: For she has brought many down to death; her slain are many in number.
targetTexts.27: Her house is the road to Sheol, descending to the chambers of death.
